description: Source code for Huffman tree builder used in compression, including class definitions, tree construction, serialization, and table conversion.

classes.name: HuffmanNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Huffman tree, with value, count, and child pointers.

methods.name: RecordUsage
methods.description: Records the usage count of a character for Huffman tree building.

methods.name: ToTable
methods.description: Converts the Huffman tree into a table of representations.

methods.name: TreeToTable
methods.description: Recursively traverses the Huffman tree to fill the representation table.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Serializes the Huffman tree into a vector of bytes.

methods.name: WriteToVector
methods.description: Writes a Huffman tree node and its children into a byte vector.

methods.name: BuildTree
methods.description: Constructs the Huffman tree from character counts.
